objective: Test whether complete mode-parameter isolation, score-gradient shielding, and deterministic expert birth improve ASCENT's fixed K=5 conditional trajectory quantizer without residuals, routing gates, tokens, autoregression, or candidate selection.
claim_boundary: C12 train and development are opened design boundaries. The locked_test partition remains sealed and is not authorized by this cycle until the complete five-seed development gate passes.

variants.a0_shared_signed: Original shared K=5 ASCENT with signed physical decoder and coupled winner cross-entropy.
variants.a1_shared_positive: Shared K=5 ASCENT with positive-speed physical decoder and coupled winner cross-entropy.
variants.a2_shared_decoupled: Shared K=5 positive-speed geometry with a separate detached Voronoi-mass scorer.
variants.a3_scaled_decoupled: Capacity control: wider/deeper shared positive-speed geometry with the same detached scorer.
variants.a4_independent_random: Five complete independently initialized K=1 ASCENT geometry experts with the detached scorer.
variants.a5_dive: Five complete experts trained with deterministic highest-distortion expert birth and the detached scorer.

gradient_audit.interpretation: The audit is diagnostic. Failure does not authorize a post-hoc threshold change; A2 remains an ablation but not a claimed mechanism.

training.geometry_objective: SmoothL1 on the detached full-trajectory winner; no score gradient reaches geometry.
training.score_objective: Cross entropy on detached Voronoi-cell membership; no geometry gradient reaches the scorer.
training.checkpoint: fixed final epoch 20; no development metric selects an epoch

dac.split_rule: expert with largest accumulated winning full-trajectory distortion
